name: headcount_insights
description: Headcount analysis skill for People Analytics. Provides ending headcount, quarterly and monthly trends, QoQ/YoY change, headcount by organization / region / geography / management level / tenure / cost center, headcount movement drivers (hires, exits, net change), org shape (manager %, span of control), and workforce composition (% new, % retained). Supports company-wide and org-scoped (executive) views with parameterized filters. Triggers: current headcount, headcount trend, headcount by org, headcount by region, headcount change, movement drivers, span of control, workforce composition, full headcount summary, YoY headcount. Do NOT use for: attrition rates or regrettable exits (use attrition_insights), manager-level org health (use org_health_report), or a leader's weekly hiring report (use hiring_brief).
